What is the equation of the circle given above?
corrected_content.worked_solution: The diagram gives center $(1,3)$ and radius $3$. Substitute into $(x-h)^2+(y-k)^2=r^2$ to obtain $$(x-1)^2+(y-3)^2=9.$$
